hint.1: One of the screens seems brighter than the others. That might be important.
hint.2: Imperial terminals process sequences left to right. Read the screens in order.
hint.3: The code is _URE — only the first symbol eludes you.

terminal.correct: Override accepted. Blast door unlocked. Proceed to the corridor.
terminal.wrong: ACCESS DENIED. Incorrect sequence. Try again.

door.locked: Blast door sealed. Complete the Imperial Override sequence first.
door.unlocked: Blast door open. Proceed to the corridor.

hint.1: A launch console near the entrance glows faintly. Three inputs are required.
hint.2: The console needs a keycard, an override code, and a launch frequency. Check your inventory.
hint.3: The frequency is broadcast on the hangar announcement display above the shuttle bay.

console.incomplete: Sequence incomplete. Collect all credentials before launch.

launch.success: All credentials verified. Force field offline. Shuttle launching — may the Force be with you.

shuttle.locked: The force field blocks the shuttle. Disable it at the launch console.

hint.1: Something in this cell might help you escape. Look carefully at your surroundings.
hint.2: The flickering light draws your eye. Is something off about that wall panel?

panel.found: A hidden maintenance keycard! This must open the cell door.

door.locked: The cell door is sealed. You need a keycard to open it.
